relations: When the fan spreads and turns edge-on, the gradient silk streamers arc overhead, sweep past her head, or trail sideways.
Lowering the fan to her waist while bending forward causes the streamers to transition from arced to trailing downwards.
Raising the fan vertically and extending it sideways makes the streamers follow the motion, creating sweeping arcs in the air.
The dancer's shifting weight and lifted leg are mirrored in the full-height mirror, confirming a single dancer's synchronized movements.
caption:
The video captures a bright indoor dance studio. A full-height mirror, ceiling fixtures and stage lamps, a ballet barre, sheer curtains, and a folded blue mat frame the space. A single dancer in a dark ink-wash top and black pants stands right of center, already manipulating a large folding fan with long gradient silk streamers, her mirror reflection moving in sync to the left.

Throughout the dance the fan is repeatedly spread into a white disc and turned edge-on. The streamers arc overhead, sweep past her head, hang vertically, or trail sideways. The fan cycles in height, held high overhead, then lowered near the waist as she bends forward. It is raised vertically in front and extended out to the side. A red bolster and black mat rest on the floor near the mirror.

Her posture shifts with the work, from upright with one arm raised to a forward bend. She turns her weight with a lifted leg in the later moments. The camera stays static, the reflection confirming a single dancer.
